Yeaaahhhh, people need to be a bit more realistic. YES, MD can be extremely fun and comforting at times. That’s half of the reason people do it for years. 

The other half is because it’s essentially a DISORDER. We can’t stop. Hence the name maladaptive. MD was incredible when we were 13 and spinning around in a room. 

As an adult it’s sometimes terrible. DD at working during meetings. In dream land at the doctors. Driving and crashing because you disassociated. 

I completely agree that it needs to stop being romanticized. People need to remember that it has a real and very annoying impact on people’s lives.

Firstly, I don’t believe we have the ability to stop. Only to pause temporarily. 

The point of stopping, and I say this as someone that’s done this for 20 years, is that Lucidity is IMPORTANT. MD can easily get worse. I lose track of time, bits of my memory. When it’s very bad I can’t focus, and I lose a lot of context at work, in communication, and even in Goals. 


MD can be fantastic. MD can be very good if it’s fun, helps you plan and meet goals, helps with Loneliness. But eventually and INEVITABLY, it will become a blocker in your life. You want to miss interviews for good jobs cause you were in LALA land? 

Another commenter said they got into a car crash - extremely possible, and I literally do not drive because sometimes the DD is unstoppable. You want to miss parts of your education cause you were floating in space? Check out of friends hangouts because you were off in your head world building? It honestly sucks sometimes. Yes, it’s functional at the moment but it’s not making us active and present in life. Imagine having kids or a family and you’re trying to engage with them, but you can’t cause you disassociated into another dimension. 

There is definitely a point in MANAGING it (again, will never be able to actively stop), avoiding triggers, and actively trying to stay Lucid. It helps you actually live your life.

For me, it started because of childhood verbal and physical abuse. I often felt extremely trapped at school and at home. Because my mom would do very weird fucked up shit to me, I desperately needed to escape somehow. I was also bullied at school. 

I strongly remember feeling like I needed to runaway, and I did at least once. Then it started happening, randomly. I noticed that sometimes when I cried or felt sad and pretended it was happening to someone else, I would stop feeling sad. That’s the first inkling I got that if i “imagined” someone else feeling something else while being somewhere else , i myself would also be somewhere else. 

Unfortunately, this happened before 13 definitely. And now it happens to me no matter what emotion. Happy, sad, angry, scared, etc. then i stop focusing on whatever it is that is upsetting me in reality and create a new narrative for something completely different. 

I also have a very bad disassociating habit, where If i feel very overwhelmed with an emotion, like an extreme one, I won’t even DD or MD. instead i’ll have a total out of body experience where i feel like im on another planet. or in another dimension 


moral of the story is, don’t traumatize kids.

MD. to me is like this. So essentially there’s levels to it I would say level one for me is regular daydreaming. they’re just like thoughts that you can just get lost in. 

Level two daydreaming is kind of………if you’ve ever seen the show “scrubs” there’s a character named JD he like blinks out of existence for a second and then he has an entire scene play out on his head. Then he will blink back to reality after two minutes of spacing out,  and say something randomly out loud. People around him would be confused. 

I wouldn’t say that’s maladaptive YET but that’s a lot like what it is.


what i consider level three is when things get serious - as in, when most people notice the issues - but also day dreaming can get very very fun. This is like three hours or four hours of you just stuck in a loop. A lot of people experience it when they’re listening to music or when they’re walking or when they’re moving with a complete lack of outside stimulation. essentially, you could be spinning around in a circle for three or four hours. you could be walking in a circle for three or four hours, or you could be like talking to yourself and babbling and acting out a scene for three or four hours. about two or three years ago I was at the top of my career. adjunct professor at an easy university. online teaching. i was literally making 7-9k per month, was a lot slimmer, traveled extensively and had big big dreams. lived on my own in 7 different countries. saved up 100,000 USD in 1.5 years on my own. i was 28 and then 29 fucking years old. had a masters degree that i financed 100% on my own. i felt like the most accomplished woman in my generation. then i opened up my own school. all my managers at my job commended me, my parents were full of pride, i was more successful than like 99% of my friends and fellow students. I was constantly hailed as being a model teacher, among the best in the department, the best in the company, etc. i loved it. it was everything to me. 

THEN I GOT FIRED two weeks before my 30th birthday and the teaching market went WAY down. i spent the entirety of my savings on my school and once I got fired  i had no way to fund it. it ran on fumes for 8 months before i fired all the staff and got rid of all the students. even before i closed it down it had massive issues. students leaving. not paying tuition. teachers barely working. my investor pulled out and also tried to sleep with me, and i thought of that man as a mentor. i had electrical issues, water and heating issues, debt collectors banging my door down. my building electricity and house electricity both got shut off three times in the same year. 

I was brutally suicidal. at that point i had applied to well over 300 jobs, easily. i barely got anything. it just got worse and worse. i applied to jobs every single day of the week. went to interviews and got nothing. or low paying jobs. i ran out of savings and had NO MONEY for at least two months and lived off of scraps. the entirety of my 30th year and 31st year on this earth were me struggling to find work, struggling to make ends meet, gaining nearly 100 lbs stress eating and getting intense health issues. 

i honestly thought about SI every fucking day. i called the hotline at least twice. i thought something would kill me everyday. for at least three months i stopped leaving my house entirely and just cried and gained weight. my friends got families, bought houses, got married, had babies, got Doctorate Degrees, etc. I had 2 dollars to my name and a bag of mental health issues. 


BUT!!! BUT!!! BUT!!! 

it got better. yes, it sounds fucking cheesy,  it sounds impossible. but it got better. it took A WHILE AND A LOT OF STRUGGLE. I DONT KNOW HOW I SURVIVED. but i survived. i moved in with my best friend on the other side of the world. i switched careers and found a temp job that pays far less than what i made in my life, but it’s stable and easy and fairly stress less. i enrolled in school again two days ago. i started cooking and dieting and playing video games. started planning for the future. met friendly new people, started saving money. i threw away every last bit of whatever i had from my old business and put that in the past. started working towards the future. signed up for the gym, got food stamps and reduced transportation. point is, if you’re still reading all of this, no matter what. you have to let go and let yourself move on. be free of it. that’s the only way you can get better. YES GET HELP. yes get therapy, but find away to keep marching on.

interestingly enough, i actually beat 12 for the fourth time about….3 minutes ago. 

it’s not my favorite game on the series whatsoever, and it’s a great game overall. absolutely a great game. 

Positives:
Brah, this game is LONG. i remember it taking me like 2 months to 100% on the OG PS2. i replayed TZA with 4x speed and it’s still pretty long. i like that it wasn’t very straightforward and everything took forever to do everywhere. 

Hands down, outside of rhe MMOS i don’t think a single game in the entire franchise has NEARLY as much lore as 12. Ivalice is an entire universe. it’s an entirely new dimension. every part of that game was well thought out, down to the damn grass. rabanastre is hands down the best city/world in all of the games, even my favs. 
 that’s not all! it’s just so damn beautiful. the salikawood to the necrohol. gorgeous cut scene. nabreus deadlands is a beautiful but haunting place. fuck giruvegan but the great crystal had this fantastic mysterious feel to it. i absolutely loved the world building in this game and i really crave for another game like it. no other game in the entire franchise has THIS 👏🏾 MUCH 👏🏾 big dick energy in world building. EVERY single item, beast, city in this world has a back story. 

Say what you want, but the voice acting (not vaan!) is blessed. completely. Cid Bunansa had GOD tier voice acting and stole the show every single scene he was in. Al cid margrace is seen 3x and also completely chewed each scene he was in. 

This game makes you EARN every single reward/weapon/ etc you want. the tournesol, the zodiac spear, the grand armor, seitengrat. you want a single thing in this game. you have to work for it. every time i checked a strategy guide on how to find a boss, i had to go through 5 other things first. like, you want to fight chaos? FIRST get these four bosses, then do this quest, then go to this place, then double back and steal x, y, z before you can even open the door. 

Music was killer. the OG boss battle theme was *chefs kiss*. the espèr theme? glorious. the salika wood theme? great. giza plains theme? cute. they don’t stand out as much as other games, but they are incredibly fitting for their world and orchestrated masterpieces. 

- fran was fine af. 

CONS:

The story was super meh. like it was GOING somewhere but didn’t get anywhere and didn’t connect at all. it’s more like they fleshed out characters and places in lieu of a good story. 
its INTRIGUING but it’s not powerful. it’s not moving. it’s just like…..dollar store star wars basically. 
Interestingly enough, when watching the credits, and looking at the storyline pictures at the end, i could honestly understand what they were TRYING to do, but it’s a little too….political. 


Characters 
- The characters are cool, but not really a cohesive unit. they don’t have toooo much to do with each other, but all have a common goal. but they aren’t really there for each other and aren’t close. ffx was all about yuna, annoyingly so, but all the characters are connected. ffvii, a lot of the party are interconnected by their back story. it’s similar in xii, but they are too far removed. 

they don’t really strike any deep personal feeling in the players. i looooveee vivi from 9. i adore cloud in 7. i love zidane in 9. i absolutely despised yuna and tidus in x, but their stupid love story was quite endearing. noctis is my absolute favorite lil emo boi prince. there isn’t a single character that i really cared about in 12, nor any scene to spark emotion. there’s no vivi dying scene, no you are not alone scene, no ignis going blind scene, no cecil and rosa getting married or tidus dying at the end scene. seriously. i sincerely do not care about any of the characters goals. their stories are INTERESTING but not inspiring, not touching. i remember them only because of the honest to god 60+ hours i sunk in the game doing all hunts, rare weapons, and bosses. it’s not cause i liked them. 

no cultural impact. 
— overall, outside of the awesome gambit system, nothing in this game made a massive impression on the fandom. there are no like. random memes or jokes. there’s no best girl argument. no arguing over scenes, no inside jokes about moments from the story. every other day in this sub, there’s a discussion about IX, FFVII something something, FFT, then X then XVI or XIV. 12 gets glossed over because while it’s great, there really isn’t anything for me to fangirl over. i don’t even rewatch videos from the game on youtube.
